security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:

bundle.shortDescription: Zoomable map of a git repository with the diff overlaid
bundle.longDescription: relief shows a git repository as a zoomable map (system, modules, files, symbols) with the diff overlaid, to review pull requests and understand an unfamiliar repo.
